svg.desc: Bar chart of 97,756 held-out outcome measurements by how the denominator attached by the flat export compares with the applicable participant denominator under the written rules.
svg.text: Denominator attached by the flat export, per measurement
Held-out confirmed cohort; n = 97,756 outcome measurements. Orange marks bars where the attached count is not, or
cannot be shown to be, the denominator of the value: the row has its own, different number analyzed, the values are
per another unit, no count can be attached safely, or the value cannot be located uniquely.
